projection.condition: Action durably accepted; action_created exists. A queued Run is not sufficient.
action_started exists AND internal dispatch eligibility is satisfied; running alone does not reconstruct eligibility.
A guarded effect_requested is recorded, with committed persistence before IO in future dispatcher. Model generation alone is not applying.
action_completed exists; effect_confirmed alone returns running and is not Action completion.
task_binding_lost from applying with unresolved effect; unrelated uncertainty must not synthesize an invalid transition.
confirmation_requested includes deadline; preserve trusted token and approval boundary.
confirmation_resolved expire, not arbitrary run deadline.
Known action_failed outcome under dated semantics; not unknown effect or invocation.
cancellation_requested in force and action_cancelled from allowed source; never cancel applying/reconciliation_required with unresolved effects.

reconcile_reasons.resolution: Probe owner by stable effect identity; append effect_confirmed/effect_failed only for known outcome under current epoch (T27/T28).

reconcile_reasons.entry: No new wire transition; T26 only when its event and guard actually hold.
reconcile_reasons.resolution: No blind effect retry; status_lookup or trusted reconciliation.
reconcile_reasons.wire_status: applying or reconciliation_required as already journaled

reconcile_reasons.entry: Operational queue metadata, never an ActionStatus.
reconcile_reasons.resolution: Operator current permission/policy and known owner outcome required; keep reconciliation_required until then.
reconcile_reasons.wire_status: reconciliation_required for an Action already in reconciliation

reconcile_reasons.entry: Invocation/Run waiting_external only; not an Action status.
reconcile_reasons.resolution: Retain invocation identity; do not equate missing response with zero usage.

reconcile_reasons.entry: Delivery/outbox only; completed Action/Run remains independently recorded.
reconcile_reasons.resolution: Reconcile by tenant delivery identity; completed is not delivered.

limitations: Projection of authoritative journal state only; not a second reducer or dispatch authorization.
